\begin{document}
Alfa ordinary paragraph, set at the full measure so that the margin of the page is
visible on its own line before any list begins here.

\begin{quote}
Bravo quoted text that is long enough to wrap onto a second line, so that both the
left and the right margin of the quotation can be read off the page.
\end{quote}

\begin{quotation}
Charlie first paragraph of a quotation, long enough to wrap onto a second line of
its own so both margins show.

Delta second paragraph of the same quotation, which LaTeX indents by listparindent
and keeps inside the same margins.
\end{quotation}

\begin{verse}
Echo first verse line\\
Foxtrot second verse line
\end{verse}

\begin{description}
\item[Golf] a description item long enough to wrap onto a second line, so that the
hanging indent of its continuation can be measured.
\item[Hotel] a short one.
\end{description}

India ordinary paragraph after the lists, at the full measure again so the margins
are seen to have come back.
